skill.name: Google Maps Nearby Store Collector

location.title: Address or coordinates
location.description: Enter a public address/place or latitude,longitude. This coordinate remains the center as the search expands across overlapping map tiles.

limit.title: Target store count (0 = all)
limit.description: Target store count. The collector searches outward across map tiles until it reaches this count or exhausts max_radius_km.

search_zoom.title: Map zoom (14–21)
search_zoom.description: Primary Google Maps zoom (14–21). Center searches also use zoom 20; cross-screen coverage uses zoom 15 and overlapping coordinate tiles.

max_radius_km.title: Maximum search radius (km)
max_radius_km.description: Maximum distance from the original coordinate. Search expands in 1 km stages and stops when the target is met or this radius is exhausted.

search_radius_km.description: Maximum allowed distance from the original center.

search_zoom.description: Zoom used by this single-center Google Maps search.

coverage_note.description: Explains bounded overlapping-tile coverage and the ranked Google Maps source limits.

requested_count_met.description: True or false for a positive requested limit; null when limit is 0 (all exposed results).
